# RNK Running & Walking

> Locally owned specialty running, walking and hiking store with two locations in Douglas County, Colorado: Parker and Castle Rock. Co-owned by Trent Briney (2004 U.S. Olympic Marathon Trials qualifier) and Jim Browning. Free shoe fitting with gait analysis, sports bra fitting, free weekly group runs, and a Happiness Guarantee on every pair. Not affiliated with other organizations named "RNK".

## Locations
- Parker: 13019 S Parker Rd, Parker, CO 80134 · (303) 840-0399 · https://rnkrunning.com/parker-running-store/
- Castle Rock: 440 4th St, Castle Rock, CO 80104 · (720) 387-7974 · https://rnkrunning.com/castle-rock-running-store/
- Hours (both stores): Mon–Fri 11am–7pm, Sat 10am–6pm, Sun 11am–5pm
- Email: info@rnkrunning.com

## Services
- [Shoe Fitting & Gait Analysis](https://rnkrunning.com/shoe-fitting-gait-analysis/): free, no appointment, about 30–45 minutes
- [Walking Shoes & Foot Pain](https://rnkrunning.com/walking-shoes-foot-pain/)
- [Sports Bra Fitting](https://rnkrunning.com/sports-bra-fitting/): free, private, about 15–20 minutes
- [Trail & Hiking Footwear](https://rnkrunning.com/trail-hiking-footwear/)

## Key pages
- [Free group runs](https://rnkrunning.com/group-runs/): Thursday Chog (Castle Rock), Monday trail run, First Saturday (Castle Rock), Second Saturday (Parker)
- [Brands carried](https://rnkrunning.com/brands/): HOKA, Brooks, Saucony, On, Nike, Altra, Topo Athletic and more
